overall_intent: A reference-guided investigator makes a suspected financial connection inspectable by matching a terminal account across screen and paper. The scene should feel like a focused act of inquiry with one traceable clue, using restrained variations at saved creativity 1.

action.reason: The present act of comparing and annotating is the main difference between an investigation and a posed office portrait.
action.expressive_goal: Make a specific investigator visibly test a financial-record connection through one purposeful action at the shutter.
observable_targets: pencil point contacting a circle around a bank-statement receiver
screen transfer chain observed while annotating the corresponding printed row
owner_relations: one investigator owns the acting right hand and stabilizing left hand
pencil point touches the printed matched account entry
subject attention connects paper to terminal transfer tile
required_constraints: examining records to test a suspected connection
reference face and hair appearance preservation only
open_scope: local refinement of action timing and arrangement
simplifying annotation or evidence placement for legibility
action.role_focus: An investigator actively verifies a suspected diverted-donation payment by comparing a terminal recipient on a transfer display with a circled entry on a paper bank statement. A visible pencil annotation carries the current action.
action.scene_context: One fictional reference-guided investigator at a quiet desk; one monitor and one paper statement share a receiving-account marker. Keep the matched evidence and the owned hand contact readable together.

grounds.quote: Examining records to test a suspected connection; authorial specific action is matching a terminal receiving account across screen and bank statement

review.author: Codex
review.rationale: This directly authored action query uses the frozen independent financial scene. Specific charity circumstances and contact mechanics remain authorial; no candidate language or data was used.

narrative_clue.reason: The record connection must be visible enough to test the investigative topic beyond generic bookkeeping atmosphere.
narrative_clue.expressive_goal: A repeated receiving account becomes a jointly visible clue across two independent records.

foreground printed row repeating A-17 and 9,800,000
fresh circle made at that matched entry
owner_relations: paper bank statement owns the corresponding receiver entry
investigator tests the relation between the two records

record observation distinguished from unproven guilt or unseen history
open_scope: small contextual clues making the evidence comparison legible
narrative_clue.role_focus: A financial investigation clue is the same receiving-account marker and amount appearing at the end of an on-screen transfer chain and on a paper bank statement. The investigator marks that specific match at the present moment.
narrative_clue.scene_context: A fictional charity-fraud inquiry at a quiet desk. The visible clue supports a suspected connection; it does not by itself prove guilt, a real identity or the full unseen money history.
